objs.name: policy
objs.description: Company-wide regulation and process at strategic level defining rules and requirements

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document describing specific procedures, process sequence, and responsible persons within a framework

objs.name: document
objs.description: General document object that can be policies, guidelines, work instructions or other document types managed in the system

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attachment subject to release cycle of main document and affects versioning

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary document information not subject to release cycle or versioning of main document

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Request to amend a document without affecting content or version history

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: Request to verify and extend document validity after defined period

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate and archive a document that has no additional validity

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to re-validate and restore a previously invalidated document

objs.name: author
objs.description: User role responsible for creating and editing document content

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: User role responsible for checking document content for technical and formal aspects

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: User role responsible for approving and releasing document to readers

objs.name: translator
objs.description: User role responsible for translating released document content to other languages

objs.name: reader
objs.description: User role with authorization to view approved documents

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of new document object with selection of document type and template

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Modification of document content using editing client with local Office component

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Definition and update of document properties and attributes in categories

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assignment of group and person-related read and write permissions to document

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Initiation of workflow-supported approval process starting with creator signature

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks document content for technical and formal compliance

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser approves and publishes document to authorized readers

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Participant applies electronic signature during workflow process step

evts.name: create_version
evts.description: Automatic creation of new document version when revising released document

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking and archiving of attachment when no longer relevant to new version

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Author creates change proposal to amend document without affecting version history

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Author processes and implements change proposal creating new document version

evts.name: request_validity_extension
evts.description: System automatic creation of validity extension request 30 days before document expiration

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Releaser or review team confirms validity extension updating valid until date

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: User with write access creates request to invalidate document with no additional validity

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Releaser or review team approves invalidation marking document and attachments out of force

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdrawal of authorizations and archiving of invalidated document for defined period

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Business Admin group creates request to re-validate previously invalidated document

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Initiator confirms reactivation restoring document and attachments to valid status

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: System sends email notification to assigned users and user groups upon document release

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: System sends workflow task to users for active confirmation of document acknowledgement

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms receipt and acknowledgement of document via email link

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translator translates released document content to another language

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Reviewer checks translated document for accuracy and compliance

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Releaser approves translation making document visible to readers in target language

o2o.description: Document has attachments that are automatically released with main document
Document has additional information supplemented to provide further details
Change Proposal belongs to and is displayed in associated document
Validity Extension Request is linked to document requiring validity check
Override Request is created for document to be invalidated
Reactivation Request references document to be re-validated
Guidelines may reference policies as part of governance system
Work Instructions provide detailed procedures within guidelines framework
Author is assigned to create and edit specific documents
Reviewer is assigned to check specific documents
Releaser is assigned to approve specific documents
Translator is assigned to translate specific documents

o2e.description: Create Document event creates new document object
Edit Document event modifies document content
Maintain Metadata event updates document properties and attributes
Assign Authorization event grants permissions on document
Submit for Review event initiates approval workflow for document
Create Version event generates new version of document
Create Change Proposal event records proposal for document amendment
Request Validity Extension event creates validity check request for document
Extend Validity event updates validity period of document
Create Override Request event creates invalidation request for document
Declare Override event marks document as out of force
Archive Document event withdraws authorizations for invalidated document
Create Reactivation Request event creates restoration request for archived document
Reactivate Document event restores validity to previously invalidated document
Distribute by Email event sends notification to assigned users upon release
Request Acknowledgement event sends confirmation task to users
Translate Document event creates language version of released document
Archive Attachment event marks attachment no longer relevant
Implement Change Proposal event processes proposal into new document version
Create Document event performed by author creating new document
Edit Document event performed by author modifying content
Submit for Review event initiated by author or co-author
Sign Document event performed by author in creation workflow step
Implement Change Proposal event performed by author processing proposal
Review Document event performed by reviewer checking content
Sign Document event performed by reviewer in review workflow step
Review Translation event performed by reviewer checking translated content
Release Document event performed by releaser approving document
Sign Document event performed by releaser in release workflow step
Extend Validity event performed by releaser confirming validity extension
Declare Override event performed by releaser approving invalidation
Release Translation event performed by releaser approving translation
Translate Document event performed by translator creating language version
Confirm Acknowledgement event performed by reader confirming document receipt
